scope: Seven supplied source records; seven primary papers. No literature expansion. Scan complexity and output accounting are explicitly atlas derivations.

representation.decision: Main categorical computation-time versus palette grid with a shared exact n+2m oracle-query line; reversible default authorized by root while optional user question remained open.
representation.axes: Both axes carry named formula categories, no numeric palette ratio and no fabricated n exponent.
representation.lower: An independent derivedBounds record gives Ω(m) output operations. It has no paperId/sourceId and is not inserted as a paper theorem in research-patch.json. No query lower bound or query-optimality claim.
representation.zoom: 738×548 labeled detail,330×245 category/marker summary,overview without any SVG text,1060×740 focused chart.
representation.colors: Green algorithms, red output-time floor. Palette colors appear in labels and faint marker halos.

sources.verified: Provides the 2Δ−1 palette observation. Atlas derives n+2m queries and straightforward O(mΔ) computation by scanning at most 2Δ−2 neighbors per edge.
sources.limitation: Not an optimal greedy implementation claim. Full DISC paper remains preprint/accepted; publication filter is conservative.

sources.location: Corollary C.1(i) in arXiv v3; Corollary B.1(i) in JACM
sources.verified: Randomized O(m log Δ) time w.h.p. for Δ+1 colors. Theorem1.1 itself gives O(m log n). Display uses log⁺ to include trivial Δ≤1.
Δ+O(log n) palette in expected O(m log Δ) time. Fallback enforces the palette on every execution, without promoting expectation to a same-order high-probability time bound.

sources.location: Theorem3's explicit runtime remark; Lemma24; Corollary25
sources.verified: Restore the additive m term omitted in the input's abstract-level formula. The corrected soft-O cost is Õ(m+min{m√n,mΔ}α/Δ), in expectation and w.h.p.
sources.reason: Without the additive term, a star gives an apparent sub-m runtime despite explicit output.

sources.verified: 0<ε<1 and Δ≥1/ε; O(m log(1/ε)/ε⁴) time with success at least1−ε^{Ω(m)}. Integer color labels are ≤(1+ε)Δ, even for noninteger q. For constant ε, linear post-scan time.
sources.normalization: log⁺ in display is a safe upper-bound convention retaining linear output cost near ε=1. Original source formula retained explicitly.
sources.support: The same source discusses straightforward greedy O(mΔ), supporting the baseline implementation derivation.

sources.verified: Randomized Õ(mn^{1/3}) time w.h.p., Δ+1 colors, general simple graphs. Retained as historical.
Randomized Õ(mn^{1/4}) time w.h.p., Δ+1 colors, general simple graphs. Retained as historical; extension subroutine is not reinterpreted as an oracle lower.

composition.oracle: Exactly n degree calls plus sum_v degree(v)=2m indexed neighbor calls; retain every undirected edge once. No further external oracle calls are made.
composition.time: Total time is O(n+m) for enumeration plus the static computation. The n term is retained when isolated vertices dominate.
composition.memory: Full O(n+m) adjacency representation retained; algorithm auxiliary memory unrestricted.
composition.outputProof: The requested output has m records. If one operation emits at most a constant number of records, emitting the output takes at least a constant multiple of m operations, even if the graph and coloring are already known.
